mapper.sql: cast(min(l.id::text) as uuid) as id, l.source_id as requirement_id, cast(max(l.target_id::text) filter (where l.target_type = 'API') as uuid) as api_id, cast(max(l.target_id::text) filter (where l.target_type = 'PAGE') as uuid) as page_id, cast(max(l.target_id::text) filter (where l.target_type = 'FLOW') as uuid) as flow_id, cast(max(l.target_id::text) filter (where l.target_type = 'CASE') as uuid) as case_id, min(l.created_at) as created_at
mapper.select:
select from asset_link l
l.deleted_at is null and l.source_type = 'REQUIREMENT' and l.source_id = cast(#{requirementId} as uuid)
group by l.source_id
and bool_or(l.target_type = 'API' and l.target_id = cast(#{apiId} as uuid))
and bool_or(l.target_type = 'PAGE' and l.target_id = cast(#{pageId} as uuid))
and bool_or(l.target_type = 'FLOW' and l.target_id = cast(#{flowId} as uuid))
and bool_or(l.target_type = 'CASE' and l.target_id = cast(#{caseId} as uuid))
order by created_at desc
mapper.insert: insert into asset_link ( id, source_type, source_id, target_type, target_id, link_type, created_at ) select cast(#{id} as uuid), 'REQUIREMENT', cast(#{requirementId} as uuid), 'CASE', cast(#{caseId} as uuid), 'VERIFIES', cast(#{createdAt} as timestamptz) where cast(#{caseId} as uuid) is not null union all select gen_random_uuid(), 'REQUIREMENT', cast(#{requirementId} as uuid), 'API', cast(#{apiId} as uuid), 'COVERS', cast(#{createdAt} as timestamptz) where cast(#{apiId} as uuid) is not null union all select gen_random_uuid(), 'REQUIREMENT', cast(#{requirementId} as uuid), 'PAGE', cast(#{pageId} as uuid), 'COVERS', cast(#{createdAt} as timestamptz) where cast(#{pageId} as uuid) is not null union all select gen_random_uuid(), 'REQUIREMENT', cast(#{requirementId} as uuid), 'FLOW', cast(#{flowId} as uuid), 'RELATED_TO', cast(#{createdAt} as timestamptz) where cast(#{flowId} as uuid) is not null on conflict do nothing
